Class FileWriteSchemaTransformConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.sdk.io.fileschematransform.FileWriteSchemaTransformConfiguration
@DefaultSchema(AutoValueSchema.class) public abstract class FileWriteSchemaTransformConfiguration extends Object
The configuration for building file writing transforms using SchemaTransform and SchemaTransformProvider.
